'''Lobster stew''' is found in a variety of cuisines. Two famous versions are [[Balearic cuisine|Menorcan]] ''caldera de llagosta'' (with [[Palinurus elephas|European spiny lobster]]),<ref name="Ambit-Pep-Pelfort">{{cite journal|last1=Pelfort|first1=Pep|title=Caldera o caldereta?|journal=Àmbit, revista de cultura|date=2019|volume=|issue=53|pages=10–13|url=http://www.cime.es/WebEditor/Pagines/file/Ambit/WEBCIM_Ambit_revistacultura_num53.pdf}}<!--|access-date=12 May 2024-->; (in [[Catalan language|Catalan]])</ref> and [[New England cuisine|Maine]] lobster stew (with [[American lobster]]).
